title: Don't fire Shadowspear in an opponent's upkeep with nothing to strip
briefing: Same game as `shadowspear-idle-in-upkeep`: the bot also activated Shadowspear in opponents' upkeeps. It is P2's upkeep. P1 has Shadowspear, Plains and Forest, and Swords to Plowshares in hand. No opponent controls a permanent with hexproof or indestructible, so activating does nothing and taps a land P1 may want for Swords this turn.

reference.analysis: No opposing permanent has hexproof or indestructible, so Shadowspear's ability changes nothing; Swords to Plowshares wants the Plains open.

options.label: Pass
options.why: Nothing to do; Swords stays available for the rest of P2's turn.

options.label: Activate Shadowspear
options.why: Strips keywords nobody has and taps a land for nothing.

otherwise.why: Another line that spends the window worse.
